research.title: Segmentation Robustness Under Image Corruptions
bullets: Designed supervisor-guided experiments comparing semantic segmentation models under blur, sensor noise, and contrast changes while holding preprocessing and evaluation procedures fixed.
Evaluated boundary errors and classwise overlap across corruption conditions, using qualitative inspection to distinguish annotation ambiguity from recurring model failures.

research.title: Foreground Reliance in Visual Recognition
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance to test whether image classifiers relied on foreground objects or background context under controlled image modifications.
Implemented foreground masking and background replacement conditions, compared classification behavior, and documented potential confounds introduced by visible compositing boundaries.

work.title: Image Upload Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented image validation and resizing components for an upload workflow, handling unsupported formats, malformed files, and inconsistent image orientation.
Added regression tests for preprocessing edge cases and investigated processing failures using application logs and reproducible examples from reported issues.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented patch descriptors and nearest-neighbor matching for overlapping images, then estimated planar transformations using robust fitting to reject incorrect correspondences.
Compared descriptor normalization and matching filters under viewpoint and illumination changes, inspecting alignment errors and failure cases involving repetitive textures.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Denoising Methods
bullets: Implemented median filtering, Gaussian smoothing, and a convolutional denoising model, using shared noisy image inputs for comparative evaluation.
Compared reconstruction error and edge preservation across noise conditions, examining oversmoothing and residual artifacts through paired visual inspection.
